messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — intake from the external assessor arrived for the ACME integration. They flagged a few RBAC misconfigurations, missing KMS key usage logs, and an old service account with broad perms. Need to plan remediation + retest window.

sanjay: thanks. can someone upload the report PDF/link here? :eyes:

sec-automation-bot: Assessment PDF uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/assessments/3687654321-acme-report.pdf (presigned exp 72h)

chris: skimmed it. priority items: 1) service-account-prod-svc has iam:roles/editor on project -> reduce to specific roles 2) kms: CMK access missing audit entries for 2025-02-14 00:00-04:00 3) old ssh key on staging gateway still in known_hosts entries

olivia: for RBAC changes, can we do a canary in dev, then a staged rollout? suggest diff like:
```
- members: [service-account-prod-svc]
- role: roles/editor
+ members: [service-account-prod-svc]
+ role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
+ role: roles/logging.logWriter
```
this is just a proposal — want infra + product signoff.

emma: agree on canary. chris, can you make the minimal iam policy PR? tag me and @sanjay for approvals.

chris: will open PR. question on KMS logs: assessor says there are gaps in audit logs for key ring "prod-keys" between 00:00-04:00 UTC. oncall-sre any idea if we rotated proxies or had a logging pipeline incident?

oncall-sre: we had a transient stackdriver export backfill failure ~2025-02-14T02:10Z affecting export to cold-storage; logs buffered in sink-dl pending reingest. I filed ops-issue#5538 and started the reingest job — running now.

emma: ok, we should capture evidence of the reingest job and the time-range fix. please attach the export job logs and a signed statement (ops) for the assessor.

sec-automation-bot: Evidence bundle (partial) uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/evidence/3687654321-reingest-logs.tar.gz

chris: opening IAM PR: https://scm.redwood.example/r/redwood/infra/+/3456 minimal change, includes canary rollout plan in PR description.

olivia: we also need to rotate the ssh key on staging gateway and show creds removal from known_hosts and from the vault entry. I'll take that.

emma: for retest windows, assessor asked for two 2-hour slots next week. propose Wed 2025-03-05 09:00-11:00 UTC and Thu 2025-03-06 16:00-18:00 UTC. any conflicts?

sanjay: Thu conflicts with release freeze. can we do Wed and Fri 2025-03-07 10:00-12:00 UTC instead?

oncall-sre: Wed slot OK for ops oncall. Fri 10-12 also fine.

emma: locking Wed 03-05 09:00-11:00 UTC and Fri 03-07 10:00-12:00 UTC then. I'll reply to assessor with those slots and ask for confirmation.

chris: PR merged to canary. rollout commands I ran:
```bash
./infra rollout iam --env=canary --policy=3456 --wait
# confirm bindings:
gcloud iam roles describe roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter --project=redwood-prod
```
Logs: small snippet showing binding change:
```
[2025-02-20T15:03:12Z] iam.binding.update: service-account-prod-svc -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

olivia: ssh keys rotated; vault entry updated, old key removed from gateway and from vault. evidence uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/evidence/3687654321-ssh-rotation.json

emma: perfect. next steps checklist for remediation tracker: 
- confirm IAM change applied to canary and monitor 1h for auth errors
- collect KMS reingest job logs + ops statement
- rotate stale service account creds (if any) and remove unused keys
- attach all evidence to the remediation ticket and notify assessor

chris: monitoring — I'll watch the canary for 90m and post metrics. if 5xx or auth failures >0.1% rollback.

sec-automation-bot: Remediation ticket created: https://tracker.redwood.example/SEC-9123 (includes links to PR, evidence, and assessor report)

emma: tagging next actions: @sanjay to draft ops statement for KMS reingest (due EOD), @chris to post canary metrics and finalize remediation ticket, @olivia to confirm ssh evidence and rotate any remaining keys.

sanjay: drafting ops statement now. will attach export job id and logs.

olivia: confirmed — no other keys found. uploaded a short proof file with diffs.

emma: assessor responded — they can do Wed slot but prefer Friday for a final verification after we finish rollout. asked them to hold both.

chris: posting canary metrics now: https://dash.redwood.example/board/iam-canary-3456 (brief: auth errors 0.02%, latency unchanged)

emma: great. once assessor confirms retest time we'll add final note to SEC-9123 and mark remediation as in-review. please keep all evidence links in the ticket.

oncall-sre: FYI created runbook snippet for future similar incidents: KB-4822 "KMS export reingest and evidence collection" with commands and locations.

emma: thanks everyone — nice quick turnaround. i'll follow up after assessor confirms slot. :thumbsup:
